title: Daily resolution
question: Is a once-a-day summary still informative?
headline: Day level: on days a related market moves ≥ 10 points, related assets' daily move exceeds unrelated by +0.23× (CI +0.16 to +0.30, 397 markets); without crypto-price markets +0.11× (CI +0.04 to +0.17).
notes: Probability sampled at each asset's daily close (16:00 ET stocks, 00:00 UTC crypto).
Pass rule: CI > 0. Not required to build; decides the daily digest.
